title: Cartwise Rewards Tier Rates for Cartwise+ Membership Waiver Offsets
content:
When a Cartwise+ Membership annual term is ended early and member fee waivers are taken off the refund of the charge that opened the term, the waiver offset rate follows the member's Cartwise Rewards tier.

| Member's Cartwise Rewards tier | Waiver offset rate |
|---|---|
| Cartwise Rewards Gold, Platinum or Diamond | 0.5 (half of the counted waivers) |
| Cartwise Rewards Silver or Bronze | 0.75 (three quarters of the counted waivers) |
| any other tier, or no Cartwise Rewards account | no rate is set under this table |

## Reading the table

- The tier is the one the member's Cartwise Rewards account shows today.
- The offset is the counted waivers multiplied by the rate, rounded to the cent.

## Hypothetical illustrations

| Tier | Counted waivers | Offset |
|---|---|---|
| Cartwise Rewards Platinum | 12.20 | 12.20 multiplied by 0.5 is 6.10 |
| Cartwise Rewards Bronze | 12.20 | 12.20 multiplied by 0.75 is 9.15 |
| Cartwise Rewards Member | 12.20 | no rate set under this table |
